title: Transportleitung
hook: Six regional trains are yours. Hold the connection, or let it go?
text: The morning at Bf Neustadt from the railway undertaking's side, alone: the regional trains RB 31 to RB 36 are yours. A feeder is announced late: ask to hold the connecting train, or let it go? Tell the passengers of every delay of three minutes or more. And your own trouble comes in for the trains later in the day: a driver calls in sick, a unit reports a defect; each has a lawful way out and a tempting one.
debrief: Which train did you hold, and for whom? Who paid for it in minutes?
What would the morning have cost by the built-in rule: never hold, cancel when in doubt?
A driver on a free day, eight hours after the last shift: what is the rule, and what does it protect?
